caption:
Toto stands on a packed train every morning, and by his stop his back and shoulder ache.

Locking your knees and hanging on with one arm can leave your back and shoulder absorbing every sway. A staggered stance with soft knees lets your legs help with balance.

Hybi's tip: stand with one foot slightly ahead of the other, keep your knees softly bent, and hold a rail at chest height, swapping hands now and then. Wear your bag on both shoulders or pop it between your feet.

Leg numbness or weakness, or back pain at night, are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD chiropractors can help. Book online via the link in bio 🚆
